name: Vigia do Passo

race.name: Orc
race.bodyProfile: Esbelto e mais velho — proposta individual candidata

role: Ideia futura de NPC e/ou personagem jogável exclusivo/único

appearance.face: A tall rangy older male Orc borderland veteran, lean sinewy limbs and a small angular head rather than a squat giant torso. Cold slate-blue grey skin, long pointed ears with one torn tip, a weathered hooked nose, unequal small ivory tusks, one clouded eye and a stern watchful expression. Long silver-white hair tied into a practical low braid and a short forked grey beard. A worn ochre leather split riding coat with a high folded collar, irregular stitched repairs, small dark iron fasteners, a fitted quilted charcoal vest, navy wrapped trousers and narrow high leather boots. No massive shoulder plates: one shoulder has a short weather-stained sheepskin drape. Many readable practical seams, folds, buckles and wear marks, with a triangular coat silhouette and a quietly dangerous veteran presence. Desaturated ochre, charcoal, faded navy and cold blue-grey; avoid crimson fabric and bright polished steel.
